name: Oncogene Suppression Array
description: Introduces multiple copies of the TP53 gene complex from elephants — animals that virtually never develop cancer despite their massive cell counts — along with enhanced DNA repair mechanisms from the tardigrade genome. The modification makes the user functionally immune to cancer. Damaged cells are identified and destroyed by the enhanced tumor-suppressor system before they can proliferate. The modification is considered essential companion therapy for telomere stabilization (to prevent the longevity treatment from also stabilizing cancerous cells) and is also offered independently as preventive medicine. Helix Biosystems bundles it with their longevity package at Tier 5. Lacuna Genomics offers a standalone version at Tier 3 that has made cancer effectively a disease of the poor in Meridian 88.
source_organism: Loxodonta africana (African elephant), Ramazzottius varieornatus (tardigrade, DNA repair genes)
procedure: Systemic retroviral injection, 6 sessions over 3 months
expression_time: 3–6 months for full expression across all cell types
side_effects: Aggressive immune responses to pre-existing benign tumors (lipomas, moles) — can cause inflammation as the system attacks them
Slightly impaired wound healing as the system scrutinizes all rapid cell growth
Rare: autoimmune responses where the system misidentifies healthy tissue as cancerous
social_perception: The clearest example of medical inequality in Meridian 88. Cancer immunity exists. It's available. It costs more than a Tier 1 resident earns in five years. Street clinics offer bootleg versions with inconsistent effectiveness.
story_hooks: A Tier 1 community discovers that a batch of bootleg cancer immunity actually works — but it was stolen from a Helix Biosystems lab, and the corponation wants it back regardless of how many people it's already saving

An oncogene suppression recipient's system begins attacking their own geneware modifications, treating the foreign DNA as cancerous — the cure is destroying the patient's other modifications one by one
